Loading a nonexistent language should produce an error.

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:tree_sitter_language_pack/tree_sitter_language_pack.dart';
import 'package:tree_sitter_language_pack/src/tree_sitter_language_pack_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    try {
      final config = await createProcessConfigFromJson(json: '{"language":"nonexistent_xyz"}');
      final result = await TreeSitterLanguagePackBridge.process('', config: config);
      stdout.writeln(result);
    } on Error catch (error) {
      stderr.writeln('${error.runtimeType}: $error');
    }
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
